summary: Completed comprehensive testing of USAGE LIMIT ENFORCEMENT - the critical new feature for Nomadly Cloud Phone service. All core limit enforcement mechanisms are properly implemented with real-time tracking, plan-based limits, and proper user notifications.

minor_issues.issue: manageNumber limit warning text formatting could be improved
minor_issues.impact: Minor - functional warnings work, just display formatting

minor_issues.issue: SMS limits initialization happens before voice service init (minor order issue)
minor_issues.impact: Minor - functionality works correctly despite order

passed_tests: Backend health endpoint operational - Node.js bot running, database connected
USAGE LIMITS CORE FUNCTIONS - All voice service limit functions implemented correctly:
getMinuteLimit() returns 100 for Starter, 500 for Pro, Infinity for Business (Unlimited)
getSmsLimit() returns 50 for Starter, 200 for Pro, 1000 for Business
isMinuteLimitReached() correctly checks minutesUsed >= plan limit, returns false for Business
isSmsLimitReached() correctly checks smsUsed >= plan limit
All limit functions properly exported: incrementSmsUsed, isSmsLimitReached, isMinuteLimitReached, getMinuteLimit, getSmsLimit
CALL HANDLING WITH LIMITS - handleCallInitiated rejects calls when isMinuteLimitReached is true
Rejected calls speak 'temporarily unavailable' message and hang up after 5 seconds
handleCallInitiated rejects calls when num.status !== 'active' (speaks no longer in service)
handleCallHangup increments minutesUsed via incrementMinutesUsed with real-time tracking
Minute billing rounds up (even 1 second = 1 minute billed) using Math.ceil
Forwarded calls properly count toward inbound minutes via incrementMinutesUsed
REAL-TIME NOTIFICATIONS - incrementMinutesUsed sends limit-reached notification when minutes hit limit
incrementSmsUsed sends limit-reached notification when SMS hits limit
Limit notifications sent only once per billing cycle using _minLimitNotified and _smsLimitNotified flags
SMS LIMITS ENFORCEMENT - initSmsLimits function exists and receives incrementSmsUsed + isSmsLimitReached
handleInboundSms checks isSmsLimitReached BEFORE forwarding - drops SMS silently if limit reached
handleInboundSms calls incrementSmsUsed after successful SMS forwarding (real-time tracking)
handleInboundSms checks num.status !== 'active' and skips if suspended
forwardSmsToTelegram message correctly says 'Inbound SMS Received' not just 'SMS Received'
SMS service is properly inbound-only (no outbound send functions found)
USER-FACING TEXT UPDATES - hubWelcome text mentions 'SMS: Inbound only' and 'Minutes: All inbound calls including forwarded count'
selectPlan text includes note about SMS inbound only and forwarded calls counting
orderSummary says 'Inbound SMS' and 'Inbound Minutes includes forwarded calls'
forwardingStatus text includes note about forwarded calls counting toward minutes
smsSettingsMenu says 'Inbound SMS Settings' and emphasizes 'inbound only'
MONTHLY RESET LOGIC - phone-scheduler.js monthly reset clears _smsLimitNotified and _minLimitNotified flags
buildUsageLimitMsg mentions 'Inbound' and explains calls rejected / SMS blocked when limits reached
runMonthlyReset function properly resets usage counters and notification flags on billing anniversary
INTEGRATION - _index.js initSmsLimits called with incrementSmsUsed and isSmsLimitReached from voice-service
All limit functions properly integrated between voice-service.js and sms-service.js
